description: One MLB team's full-season record and stats for one year, from the SABR Lahman Baseball Database (1871-2025): wins/losses, division/league/World Series result, runs scored and allowed, team batting and pitching totals, home park and attendance. Pass team as a 3-letter-ish code ("NYA", "BOS") or a common name ("Yankees", "Red Sox", "Dodgers") -- codes changed for some relocated/renamed franchises over the years (e.g. the Athletics' code changed for 2025), so an unrecognized code for that year is refused with a clear error rather than an empty success; try the franchise's name instead, or call with a nearby year to see what code that franchise used.
name: baseball_team_season
title: Baseball Team Season
